svg.title: Black Diagonal II
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-diagonal-02-2009/lightbox/works/black-diagonal-ii-2008-30777; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
